title: MgO/NiCoFe2O4 modified electrochemical sensor for simultaneous detection of ascorbic acid and levofloxacin
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18891-18903
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00424E, Paper

Iram Gul Chandio, Jameel Ahmed Baig, Imam Bakhsh Solangi, Huma Shaikh, Latif Ullah Khan, Sajjad Hussain, Saima Perveen, Faisal K. Algathami, Nadeem Raza
The current study aimed to synthesize and characterize magnesium oxide–bimetallic nickel cobalt ferrite nanohybrid (MgO/NiCoFe2O4-NH) for its application in the simultaneous electrochemical detection of ascorbic acid (AA) and levofloxacin (LEV).
